parts.label: c
parts.technique: Finding angle between two vectors (scalar product primary method, cosine rule alternative)
parts.reason: The main mark scheme method uses the scalar/dot product, a concept not named in any P10 statement (P10.1-10.5 list magnitude, addition, position vectors, distance, but never dot/scalar product), which per the exclusion rule for unnamed concepts would make it OUT; however the mark scheme offers a full-marks alternative using the cosine rule (explicitly in P5.1) applied to vector-derived side lengths, so full marks are achievable via an in-spec method.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Finding point D on a line so triangle areas are in a given ratio
parts.reason: This can be solved via proportional reasoning on the line (AD is a scalar multiple of AB since triangles CAD and CAB share the same height from C, and D lies on the same line), using position vectors and ratios - core P10.4/P10.5 content - without requiring the angle from part (c), so a fully in-spec method achieves full marks.
